description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the AuthorizationCodeRepository in the OAuth module, testing functionalities such as creation, persistence, revocation, and status checking of authorization codes within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: AuthorizationCodeRepositoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing AuthorizationCodeRepository's functionalities related to OAuth authorization codes in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test fixtures by loading configuration data from a YAML file before each test.

methods.name: testGetNewAuthCode
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new AuthCodeEntity object and ensures proper initialization, including handling of uninitialized properties.

methods.name: testPersistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Tests persisting a new authorization code to the database and verifies that all properties are correctly stored.

methods.name: testPersistNewAuthCodeWithExistingAuthCode
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to persist an authorization code with a duplicate identifier throws a UniqueTokenIdentifierConstraintViolationException.

methods.name: testRevokeAuthCode
methods.description: Checks that an authorization code can be revoked successfully and that its revoked status is updated.

methods.name: testRevokeNonExistingAuthCode
methods.description: Ensures that revoking a non-existent authorization code does not cause errors.

methods.name: testIsAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Tests whether the system correctly reports revoked and non-revoked authorization codes.

methods.name: testIsAuthCodeRevokedForNonExistingAuthCode
methods.description: Checks that querying revocation status for a non-existent code returns true, indicating revoked or invalid.
